dex.entry: The Keystar-kin. At the heart of the Umbral Spire, sealed within the Ninth Lantern, rests the being that the old Vesperholm star-tenders simply called the First Light — the original anchor of the Keystar, the central star without which no other constellation can hold. art.silhouette: A tall, upright cervine figure — like a great stag, but made entirely of woven starlight. No hard edges: the silhouette blooms and shifts like a constellation drawing. The body is a deep midnight-blue field shot through with dense white-gold star-points; the antlers are open latticework of pure light, each tip a true star. The eyes are two full-disc pupils of warm solar gold. At rest it looks like a lantern-constellation stepped down from the sky. In battle it pulses with ever-brightening rings of diamond-cyan. The art reads iconic at every sprite size.
